title: Oprah's Favorite Things 2025 Just Dropped - These Are the 10 Best Kitchen and Food Gifts - NewsBreak
text:
By Sage Anderson ,
13 hours ago Including top picks from Ninja, Breville, Ooni, and more.
Food & Wine / Getty Images / Amazon
Oprah Winfrey has done it again. The multi-hyphenate is well-known for her gifting expertise, and Oprah Daily just revealed the annual Favorite Things list . We’re professional kitchen gift-givers ourselves, and we think this year’s roundup might be her most delicious one yet. Though the 2025 collection has over 110 items spanning categories like tech, beauty, and more, the biggest standouts are the food and kitchen picks that would make perfect holiday gift for the foodies on your list.
Oprah’s Favorite Things 2025 includes sleek blenders that travel as easily as you do, an indoor pizza oven for pies all winter long, and the viral Ninja appliance that can ice cream-ify nearly anything. As she puts it, these are the “little luxuries and clever finds” that celebrate the people (and plates) we love most. New to this year’s OFT is Oprah Daily’s Gift Finder, presented by Snapdragon. This AI-assisted search tool can help you find the best gift ideas based on who you’re shopping for, sifting through hundreds of Oprah Daily’s gift recommendations — including past Favorite Things — to offer spot-on suggestions.
Below, we’ve rounded up the 10 best Oprah-loved food and kitchen finds to gift your loved ones this year.
Best Food and Kitchen Products on Oprah’s Favorite Things List Ninja Swirl by Creami, $350, originally $395 at amazon.com Breville The Oracle Jet Espresso Machine, $2,000 at amazon.com Sabatino Luxury Truffle Nut Medley, $80 at amazon.com Beast Go Cordless Blender, $114 at amazon.com Ooni Volt 2 12-Inch Electric Pizza Oven, $700 at amazon.com Estoublon Picholine Extra Virgin Olive Oil, $60 at amazon.com Sur La Table Smash Burger Kit, $45 at surlatable.com Schmidt Brothers Bonded Ash 7-Piece Knife Set, $300 at crateandbarrel.com Mosh Festive Fuel Variety Pack, $60 at amazon.com MacKenzie-Childs 2-Slice Toaster, $170 at amazon.com Ninja Swirl by Creami Amazon
$395
Dessert lovers, rejoice: This countertop marvel makes ice cream, sorbet, gelato, and protein-packed soft serve in minutes. With 13 one-touch programs (six dedicated just to ice cream), it turns frozen fruit or yogurt into creamy perfection that rivals your favorite scoop shop. Oprah calls this clever ice cream maker “creamy [and] dreamy.”
Breville The Oracle Jet Espresso Machine Amazon
For anyone who believes coffee is an art form, this espresso machine is a dream come true. The Oracle Jet automatically grinds, tamps, brews, and froths, producing café-quality espresso drinks at the touch of a button. Oprah loves that it can even make cold brew in under three minutes. With its intuitive touchscreen, it’s a splurge that transforms your counter into a full-fledged coffee bar — no barista skills required.
Sabatino Luxury Truffle Nut Medley Sabatino
The Sabatino family — famous for taking Oprah truffle-hunting in Italy — has now infused that same truffle flavor into a gourmet nut mix. Each bite combines sea salt, maple bourbon, and a whisper of truffle, elevating what’s usually a simple snack. Gift this one to the person who always reaches for “just one more handful.”
Beast Go Cordless Blender Amazon
According to Oprah, “Rechargable devices are having a moment,” and for the everyday smoothie lover, this cordless personal blender delivers premium performance wherever you want to go. Equipped with a USB-C rechargeable battery and spill-proof lids, it’s not only strong enough to handle your protein shakes, but it can easily become a kitchen mainstay for whipping up dressings, dips, and even grinding coffee beans.
Ooni Volt 2 12-Inch Electric Pizza Oven Amazon
Oprah says there’s no debate: The best pizza oven might just come from the great indoors. The Ooni Volt 2 heats up to a blistering 850°F, cooking 12-inch pizzas with a crispy, restaurant-worthy crust in around 90 seconds. Plus, the electric design means you can make perfect pies indoors all year long, rain, snow, or shine. It doesn’t matter if you’re a thin-crust traditionalist or prefer deep-dish decadence, because this workhorse handles it all.
Estoublon Picholine Extra Virgin Olive Oil Amazon
If ever there were such a thing as a showpiece olive oil , this would be it. Cold-pressed in Provence from Picholine olives, Estoublon’s vibrant and peppery oil feels indulgent yet practical, and it doesn’t hurt that the bottle is as beautiful as what’s inside. Oprah recommends bringing it to a dinner party: “I would bring it with a fresh loaf of bread.”
Sur La Table Smash Burger Kit Sur La Table
Diner-style burgers just got even easier to make at home. This 3-piece kit includes a cast iron press, seasoning shaker, and sturdy spatula for flipping like a pro. Oprah says it’s ideal for getting that iconic “sizzling, crispy crust.” Pair it with a cold beer, and you’ve got happiness on a bun.
Schmidt Brothers Bonded Ash 7-Piece Knife Block Set Crate & Barrel
Oprah includes a knife set every year, and we approve of her 2025 favorite. A great knife set is the cornerstone of any kitchen; this 7-piece option, crafted from high-quality German steel with sculpted ash wood handles, was built to last. The set includes a bread knife , chef's knife , slicer, santoku, tomato/bagel knife, paring knife, and magnetic block.
Mosh Festive Fuel Variety Pack Amazon
Created by Maria Shriver and her son Patrick Schwarzenegger, these brain-boosting protein bars could be the most meaningful snack on the list. They’re crafted with only 3 grams of sugar, and a portion of the proceeds benefits the Women’s Alzheimer’s Movement. Wrapped in festive packaging, they’re perfect for stocking stuffers, or really anyone aiming to snack smarter.
MacKenzie-Childs Check 2-Slice Toaster Amazon
This cheerful toaster , decked out in MacKenzie-Childs’ iconic check pattern, turns your morning toast into the prettiest part of your breakfast routine. It’s sturdy, stylish, and guaranteed to brighten the kitchen with every use.
